question.text: Let S be a set of 5 elements and $\mathrm{P}(\mathrm{S})$ denote the power set of S. Let E be an event of choosing an ordered pair ($\mathrm{A}, \mathrm{B}$) from the set $\mathrm{P}(\mathrm{S}) \times \mathrm{P}(\mathrm{S})$ such that $\mathrm{A} \cap \mathrm{B}=\emptyset$. If the probability of the event $E$ is $\frac{3^{p}}{2^{q}}$, where $p, q \in N$, then $p+q$ is equal to $\_\_\_\_$
